---
name: make-thread
description: Make and post a Threads thread (3 to 6 posts, page 1 of the paper as the image, Instagram reel link at the end) about one arXiv paper: prepare, draft, independently check, show the human, then post the chain. Runs by itself at the end of /make-reel once the reel is live; can also be run alone with a paper link.
---
<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-agents.mjs from .claude/agents. Do not edit. -->

Argument: an arXiv URL or id, and optionally an Instagram reel URL.

Run from `content-creation/`. The posting code is `uploader/scripts/post_thread.js`. Style rules are in `data/threads/STYLE.md`.

1. **Prepare.** `node scripts/thread-prep.mjs <url>`. It downloads the PDF if missing, extracts the text, and renders page 1 to `data/threads/<id>/page1.png`. Open the PNG yourself: title, authors and abstract must be readable.
2. **Draft.** Spawn `thread-writer` with the id and the paths. It writes `thread.json` and `numbers.md`.
3. **Check.** Spawn `thread-checker`. On FAIL, send the failures to the same `thread-writer` (SendMessage), ask which posts changed, and check again, naming those posts so the checker re-checks only them. Stop after three rounds and report what is still failing. Never let the writer judge its own draft.
4. **Find the reel link.** If the caller gave an Instagram URL, use it. Otherwise run `node scripts/reel-links.mjs <id>` and take `instagram`. If it is `null`, no reel is live: continue without the link (the poster drops the placeholder line) and say so to the human.
5. **Approve.** Show the human the image, every post in full with its byte count, the checker's verdict and the reel link.
   - `settings.autopublish` is off (default; see `node paper-reels/bin/reels.mjs settings`): wait for the human's explicit yes for this thread. A yes given before the draft existed does not count.
   - `settings.autopublish` is on: post after a checker PASS and say what you posted.
6. **Post.** `node uploader/scripts/post_thread.js data/threads/<id>/thread.json --ig-url <url>` (leave out `--ig-url` when there is no reel). Run it once. It hosts the image, posts the chain, checks that each post replied to the one before it, writes `result.json`, and records the thread in the database (`threads_thread`). It refuses to post a second thread for the same item. Do not use `--force-repost` unless the human asked and the old thread is taken down and marked DELETED. If it fails part way, report the posts that are live and stop; do not post the rest by hand.
7. **Report** the URL of post 1 and the number of posts.

If the token expired (API error code 190), run `node uploader/scripts/threads_refresh.js`. If that also fails, the human must make a new token in the Meta App Dashboard.

Rules: no thread without a PASS from `thread-checker`. No post without the human having seen the final text, unless autopublish is on. Do not post to Threads communities: the API has no documented route for them.
